title: StarHarness: Evolving Harnesses with Stratified Search for Enterprise Environments
abstract: arXiv:2608.24804v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present StarHarness, a framework for evolving environment-specific agent harnesses while keeping model weights fixed. The evolved harness can include prompt and task framing, tool interfaces, skills, MCP-backed providers, subagent structure, and agent-loop configuration. StarHarness constructs a compact evolution pool by stratifying tasks according to baseline failure behavior, separates proposer-visible search tasks from proposer-hidden selection tasks, and reserves held-out tasks for evaluating generalization. Across ITBench SRE, EnterpriseOps-Gym ITSM, and AutomationBench Finance, harness evolution improves full-benchmark performance by 20-35 percentage points over the default harness after 4-12 accepted changes per environment. These gains persist on tasks excluded from evolution and transfer without re-evolution across GPT and Qwen model families. Trace analysis links the improvements to interface repairs, environment conventions

translated_title: StarHarness：面向企业环境的基于分层搜索的装备进化框架
translated_abstract: 我们提出了StarHarness，一个在保持模型权重固定的同时，进化环境特定代理装备的框架。进化后的装备可包括提示和任务框架、工具接口、技能、基于MCP的提供者、子代理结构以及代理循环配置。StarHarness通过根据基线失败行为对任务进行分层，构建一个紧凑的进化池，将提议者可见的搜索任务与提议者隐藏的选择任务分离，并保留留出任务用于评估泛化能力。在ITBench SRE、EnterpriseOps-Gym ITSM和AutomationBench Finance基准上，装备进化在每次环境接受4-12次更改后，将全基准性能比默认装备提升20-35个百分点。这些增益在排除进化之外的任务上依然持续，并在GPT和Qwen模型家族间无需重新进化即可迁移。痕迹分析将改进归因于接口修复和环境约定。
tldr: StarHarness通过分层搜索进化代理装备，在不改变模型权重的情况下，将企业环境基准性能提升20-35个百分点，且改进可泛化并跨模型迁移。
en_tdlr: StarHarness evolves agent harnesses via stratified search, boosting enterprise benchmark performance by 20-35 percentage points without changing model weights, with gains that generalize and transfer across model families.
